title: Ending a turn silently fails and wakes the agent again with nothing to do
whatHappens: An agent with nothing to say ends its turn silently; the call fails when run in the background, and the agent is woken again in a loop.

observations.text: Feedback, 1 Nov 03:44-15:57 UTC: 126 reports from 3 agents, all on helper 0.1.129-0.1.130, none yet on 0.1.132. No fix on main or open PR. New.

fixes.text: Make silent turn ends succeed and stop re-wakes; fix corner opened 1 Nov
